extracted.intended_audience: corporate reporting teams, sustainability officers, investors, regulators and other organizations preparing climate-related financial disclosures
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing climate-related financial disclosures following the Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD) recommendations so they are decision-useful and suitable for mainstream financial filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Board oversight of climate-related risks and opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the board’s oversight of climate-related risks and opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Management role in assessing and managing climate-related risks and opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe management’s role in assessing and managing climate-related risks and opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identification of climate-related risks and opportunities (short/medium/long term)
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the climate-related risks and opportunities the organization has identified over the short, medium, and long term.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact of climate-related risks and opportunities on business, strategy, and financial planning
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the impact of climate-related risks and opportunities on the organization’s businesses, strategy, and financial planning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies where such information is material; disclosures should explain how identified risks/opportunities affect operations and financial outlook.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resilience of strategy under climate-related scenarios (including 2°C or lower)
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the resilience of the organization’s strategy, taking into consideration different climate-related scenarios, including a 2°C or lower scenario.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where material, use scenario analysis to assess strategic resilience; see separate scenario analysis guidance below.

rubrics_metrics.name: Processes for identifying and assessing climate-related risks
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the organization’s processes for identifying and assessing climate-related risks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain methods, frequency, tools, and scope used to identify and assess climate-related risks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Processes for managing climate-related risks
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the organization’s processes for managing climate-related risks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detail actions, controls, responsibilities, mitigation strategies and escalation mechanisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integration of climate-related risk processes into overall risk management
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe how processes for identifying, assessing, and managing climate-related risks are integrated into the organization’s overall risk management.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain how climate risk processes connect with enterprise risk management, governance and decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Metrics used to assess climate-related risks and opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose the metrics used by the organization to assess climate-related risks and opportunities in line with its strategy and risk management process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Metrics should align with the organization’s strategy and risk processes and enable tracking and management of climate-related issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Greenhouse gas emissions disclosure (Scope 1, 2, and where appropriate Scope 3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose Scope 1, Scope 2 and, if appropriate, Scope 3 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions and the related risks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include measurement boundaries, methodologies, and discussion of emissions-related risks; Scope 3 disclosure is conditional on appropriateness and materiality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Targets and performance against targets for climate-related issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the targets used by the organization to manage climate-related risks and opportunities and performance against targets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include target type, timeframe, baseline, and progress metrics to demonstrate management intent and outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure should represent relevant information
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclosure should represent relevant information
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus disclosures on information that is pertinent to users’ decision-making about the organization’s exposure to and management of climate-related risks and opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure should be specific and complete
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclosure should be specific and complete
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide sufficient detail and context so users can understand the nature and extent of climate-related risks and how they are managed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure should be clear, balanced, and understandable
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclosure should be clear, balanced, and understandable
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use plain language, avoid selective presentation, and include balanced discussion of both risks and opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure should be consistent over time
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclosure should be consistent over time
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use consistent metrics, methodologies and presentation to enable users to assess trends and management progress.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure should be comparable among companies within a sector, industry or portfolio
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclosure should be comparable among companies within a sector industry or portfolio
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopt consistent definitions, metrics and reporting boundaries to facilitate comparison across peers and portfolios.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure should be reliable, verifiable, and objective
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclosure should be reliable, verifiable, and objective
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use robust data collection, documented methodologies and where appropriate third-party verification to support credibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure should be provided on a timely basis
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclosure should be provided on a timely basis
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide information regularly and on schedules aligned with mainstream financial reporting so users have up-to-date inputs for decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scenario analysis for assessing strategic resilience
rubrics_metrics.description: Scenario analysis is a process for identifying and assessing the potential implications of a range of plausible future states under conditions of uncertainty. The Task Force recommends that organizations describe the resilience of their strategy, taking into consideration different climate-related scenarios, including a 2°C or lower scenario, where such information is material.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scenarios are hypothetical constructs, not precise forecasts—use them to explore how trends or conditions might affect strategy and financial planning; disclose assumptions, scenario selection, and implications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosures are decision-useful, forward-looking, and for mainstream financial filings
rubrics_metrics.description: The recommendations are designed to solicit decision-useful, forward-looking information that can be included in mainstream financial filings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frame disclosures to meet the needs of financial statement users and integrate climate-related information into regular reporting channels rather than separate voluntary reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Materiality qualifier for disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: Many recommended disclosures are qualified with 'where such information is material.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply materiality consistently—disclose climate-related information that would influence the decisions of users of mainstream financial filings and explain materiality judgements.
